cliOutputs.prompt: make a test file called temp_file1.md write at least 10 lines of text to it, then call your built-in edit tool to make 2 separate edits on the file at different locations. The first edit just edit one line. The second edit, try to edit 2 lines in different locations at the same time. Then use a shell or bash command to copy the file to temp_file2.md  After copying to temp_file2, if you have a multi-edit command, use it to edit both temp_file and temp_file2 at the same time. Don't take shortcuts, do each step as a separate command. This is a test to check FlightPath's diff rendering and bash rendering in the output window, and we want to see what each action looks like separately.
